title: Admin Login | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Admin Login Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000028835 In this article, we are going to cover: Logging in as an admin. Retrieving, modifying or adding a new password. Emails on the "Block" List. How to Access the Admin Login Page Go to: http://managemydirectory.com This page is for website owners and admins. Not for website members/users. Login as an Admin Enter the admin email and password Then click on " Log In Now » " to enter the admin. Reset an Admin Password Click on " I forgot my password" : Enter the Account Email Address and click on "Send Password Reset Email »" : Shortly, the " Reset Password " email will be sent: The link will redirect to this page where the new password is entered: Emails on the Bounce/Block List On rare occasions an email may be on the "bounce" or "block" email list, which can prevent the password reset or 2FA emails from being delivered properly. There are a few reasons this can happen, but the system will automatically clear emails from these lists and explain why, so the admin knows if anything needs fixing. Update Password in the Admin Area It is only possible to change the password for a personal account and not other admin accounts. Go to: Settings » Admin Accounts Click on Edit : Update the password and/or contact information if necessary: Then save the changes. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
